purpose: Create a source-only cute V9 daily-down attention pose whose reflections, brows and mouth can be exported as separate choreographed components.

reference.usage: The locked V9 image is the only identity reference supplied to the generator. Earlier V36 attempts remain audit evidence and are not prompt inputs.

output_contract.format: one unlabelled 200x200-equivalent V9 daily-down attention source face; no grid, text, border or alternate state
output_contract.pixel_intent: clean monochrome black ink on a plain white background; no grey, color, texture or shading
generated_components_allowed_for_export: enclosed white large glossy oval reflection
enclosed white small four-point companion sparkle

daily_down_semantics.eyes: same bright V9 large vertically soft oval and small four-point sparkle, together modestly lower than rest and never a pupil-like disc
daily_down_semantics.brows: a very small lower-and-inward attentive answer, still soft and cute rather than angry, worried or sleepy
daily_down_semantics.mouth: a restrained soft V9-like mouth response that keeps warmth and does not become an open surprise or frown
daily_down_semantics.hold: at native 200x200, the combined component relation reads as a calm cute lowered-attention glance, clearly distinct from Daily rest

protected_identity: V9 outer black eye silhouette, placement and scale

forbidden: replace or edit the locked V9 source file
large lower circular white disc, dot-only eye, detached sparkle, cross-eye placement or extra charm
angry, worried, sad, sleepy, surprised, blank or generic face
new outer eye silhouette, eye size or eye placement
full-face runtime frame, full-face animation loop or full-face state card
legacy art, custom LUT, code-drawn eye, candidate activation, provisioning or firmware flash

owner_rejection.reason: The independent daily-down endpoint is not cute enough; center replaces it as the resting/lowered-attention presentation.

required_machine_gates_before_use: generated source SHA256 and lineage record
outer-eye identity plus single-charm comparison against locked V9
native-200 down-attention readability and cute-gloss evidence after locked-V9-body reassembly
component-only export of exactly allowed source component groups with legal coordinates
